Add Canary Islands NIF to Checkout and Tax ID Element types (#1002)

* types: support Canary Islands NIF in Checkout and Elements

Include ic_nif in the public tax ID unions so TypeScript integrations can submit and prefill Canary Islands NIFs without casts. Cover the value in Checkout update results and Tax ID Element defaults, events, and retrieved values.

Committed-By-Agent: codex
Orbit-Session-Id: 6558bd60-0ca6-484e-909d-2b326ae25422
Co-authored-by: codex <noreply@openai.com>

* types: remove redundant tax ID type fixtures

Keep the Canary Islands NIF addition scoped to the public tax ID unions, following the existing pattern for tax ID additions. Retain the original type fixtures.

Committed-By-Agent: codex
